name: footer
title: Footer
description: Site footer with brand block, link groups, and a legal line; columned or single-row.

variants.name: columns
variants.description: Brand block, link groups, and a full-width legal line; omit data-uifa-variant.

variants.name: simple
variants.description: Single row: wordmark and legal line via `data-uifa-variant="simple"`.

docs: Columned footer: brand copy under `data-uifa-slot="brand"` (wordmark plus note), link groups as `data-uifa-slot="group"` navs with `data-uifa-slot="heading"` labels, and `data-uifa-slot="legal"` spanning the full width. Variant `simple` (via `data-uifa-variant="simple"`) is a single wordmark + legal row for lean pages.
